chapter_title: [Concerning the Five] War[s that the] Sons of [Li]

fills.notes: Five worlds are the five dark elements (smoke, fire, wind, water, darkness) under the King of Darkness; the substrate regularly calls them “worlds of Darkness.”
After “net (living soul)” the needed action is the throwing/setting of the net in order to seize rulers.
Parallelism requires two capture-verbs: cast/set the snare, then bind/fetter in it.
“the face of the …” in this war-context is the adversarial manifestation of Darkness confronted by the Living Man.
The phrase is enumerative: “his virgin, the living fire, and in … they did not find…” linking her action/presence to the trapping.
Purpose clause: living fire blocks escape from the net.
Reinforces repeated net-imagery: not only trapped, but “also” caught like fish.
Transitions from fish-simile to taking “the five counsels…” (inner deliberations of the five elements).
Matches the next sentence’s cutting/digging: extraction of roots corresponds to removing the inmost will of the five dark natures.

fills.fill: which he waged against the rulers of the Darkness
fills.notes: Second war is the binding/ordering of the already-captured rulers; the opponent is the same dark archontic host.
After “middle …” the substrate sequence is: suspend rulers in the mid-region/firmament and then arrange luminaries as measures.
Stars require “courses” (measures/time). Then the narrative returns to “he set … the earths …”.
Verb required before “the earths … them in the three vessels.”
Cosmic ordering: division into three vessels (often sky/air/earth or sun/moon/stars as vessels) presupposes an act of dividing/assigning.
Rulers wish to “escape” before binding; fits immediate rationale “since they knew… he might bind…”
“many aspects… numerous …” in this layer is “powers/forces” (forms of operation), not devotional titles.
Idiomatic closure: none could save themselves; they “could not find a way” out of his skillful imprisonment.
Causal transition: “Now, since he had bound them…” leading to further trapping/setting in places.

fills.fill: in their places and in their measures
fills.notes: Correspondentially, binding fixes each power into a determinate function/measure within the ordered cosmos.
Third Ambassador displays image “in the height” so that what is below responds; classic lure/manifestation motif.
Purpose: image is shown so that the lower mixture yields up light.
Links to the next verb “scooped … all light”.

fills.fill: that was mixed in the bodies
fills.notes: What is “below” is the mixture; “scooped out all light” presumes light is mixed/hidden in bodies/forms.
“property … the ones that are consumed” points to the rulers consuming light; thus “property of the rulers” (their plunder).
Clarifies “the ones that are consumed by them” (the rulers) as consumers of light.
He removes “the entire ruling-power” of its stolen light; stripping is the correspondential act of taking away borrowed splendor.
Explains “pride of the light” as usurped adornment taken from Light.
Light is gathered and returned upward into storehouses/treasuries (vessels of Light).
The parable-like line in this substrate is functional: a powerful one comes “against the strong man” to plunder his goods.
Completes “he takes his riches from him…”.
Ruling-power compared to a hoarder/robber; “treasuries” keeps the cosmological register of stored light/wealth.
“all riches …” are ill-gotten: light taken by robbery from the mixture.
“as they travel … light …” implies movement through the cosmos/worlds during purification/separation.
Purification is separation of light from the mixed substance; matches “He cleansed and purified it.”
When chains loosen, the rebels relapse into agitation; requires a fall/renewed motion leading to renewed binding.
Jesus’ war re-imposes fetters and suppresses rebellion; aligns with “brought … a rebellion … girded himself … all of it another time.”
“he came and brought …” requires indirect object: brought (judgment/word) to them, producing/ending rebellion.
“brought … a rebellion” in this substrate sense is “brought it to cease/end,” not incited it.
Girding corresponds to taking on protecting/truth-form; oldest layer prefers impersonal “armour of light” over later devotional phrasing.
Kept as given; fits the function: imparting hope/knowledge to Adam (first human mind) toward ascent.

fills.fill: and he instructed him to look
fills.notes: Hope to Adam is operational: instruction/turning of the inner sight toward the “light ship” (vehicle of ascent).
Fifth war (counsel of life = summons/obedience) addresses the final phase: separating the remaining mixture in the world.
“summons and the obedience” are the paired operations of the Call; “great call” suits oldest register.
“great … and it placed …” requires a noun like “power/force” describing the counsel’s efficacy.
The counsel “placed a seal” corresponds to fixing boundaries so death cannot mingle again.
“upon the … and the …” likely “living and the dead”; first term restored as “living.”
Completes the pair living/dead as discrete states separated by the seal.
At this stage, the work is separation at the root (inmost) of death from life; fits “of death, which … with it.”
Death “had mingled with it” (with life/light) describes the mixture-condition being undone.
Victorious over “it” = the last rebellion/death-power just mentioned.
Kingdom given is the stable dominion of Light (order restored permanently).

assessment: Most gaps here are not constrained by surviving letter-traces, so restorations rely on the internal sequence of the five ‘wars’ and standard correspondential operations in the oldest cosmological layer: (1) capture by net/soul, (2) binding and cosmic arrangement into measures, (3) lure/manifestation to extract light from mixture, (4) re-fettering and structural completion with imparted hope/knowledge to the first human, (5) final sealing/separation of life from death. Several short connective fills are tentative because multiple Coptic-compatible formulae could fit without the manuscript’s exact wording.
